title: Marche Undercuts the National Average as Diesel Prices Swing Sharply
dek: Fresh MIMIT data for July 31 shows Marche drivers paying less than the rest of Italy at the pump, with self-service diesel down nearly 5% in a single day before a modest rebound.
body: In Marche, self-service Benzina is averaging €1.9885 per liter and self-service Gasolio €2.0857, as of July 31, 2026. Both sit below the national self-service averages of €2.0074 for Benzina and €2.1079 for Gasolio — Marche drivers are paying roughly a cent less per liter on petrol and just over two cents less on diesel than the country as a whole.

The past week tells two different stories. Benzina in Marche crept steadily upward, from €1.9711 on July 25 to €1.9885 on July 31 — a slow, unbroken climb. Gasolio moved the opposite way: after holding near €2.18-2.19 through most of the week, it plunged nearly 5% overnight on July 29 to €2.0672, and has only partially recovered since, closing the week down 4.4% from where it started. Behind those numbers, 735 of the region's 776 registered stations reported prices on the 31st — a 94.7% reporting rate that points to an active, well-monitored local network.

caption:
Today's Fuel Dashboard spotlight: Marche, where self-service diesel just swung nearly 5% in a single day.

As of July 31, 2026, Marche drivers are paying €1.9885/L for self-service Benzina and €2.0857/L for self-service Gasolio — both below Italy's national self-service averages of €2.0074 and €2.1079. But the real story is the volatility: Gasolio prices in the region dropped almost 5% overnight on July 29 before partially rebounding, while Benzina climbed steadily all week.
